name: Sequential Image Composition with Bounding Box and Chunking
definition: A communication scheme for image composition where the compositing processor receives each processor's local image one at a time using a handshaking protocol to prevent buffer overflow.
summary: Sequential Image Composition with Bounding Box and Chunking is a parallel image composition scheme that prevents buffer overflow by sequentially receiving and chunking data, differing from direct send by strictly serializing reception and managing buffer constraints.
